sents.sent_origin: My parents have always convinced me to challenge myself, for which I'm really grateful.
sents.sent_tran: 我的父母一直说服我去挑战自己，对此我非常感激。

sents.sent_tran: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。

sents.sent_origin: However, for those of you with a positive mind, opportunity lies in each challenge.
sents.sent_tran: 但是，对你们当中思维积极的人来说，机会存在于每一个挑战中。

sents.sent_origin: When you rise to the challenges, you will have the opportunity to acquire great knowledge and enjoy personal growth.

sents.sent_tran: 他们帮助学生获得未来成功所必需的技能。

sents.sent_origin: We live in an age of rapid technological advance.
